widgets_values: The camera pushes in and rises toward a young woman in a long red cloak standing at the foot of broad stone stairs that climb to a terrace with a tall stone arch gate, two cypress trees on either side.

The target video is a photoreal, naturally lit fantasy film shot on a 35 mm lens in warm late afternoon sun, with soft contrast, gentle film grain and a clear pale blue sky. [Shot 1] A young woman in a long deep red wool cloak, hood down, dark hair tied back, stands still on worn sandstone flagstones at the foot of a broad flight of eight pale sandstone steps, her back to the camera, looking up the stairs. The stairs climb to a wide raised stone terrace edged by a low weathered wall, and at its centre stands a tall round-topped arch gate of honey-coloured sandstone blocks, open sky and distant blue hills seen through it. A tall dark green cypress tree stands on either side of the foot of the stairs. Moss grows in the joints of the steps, a few dry leaves lie on the flagstones, and long soft shadows fall across the stone toward the camera. The camera starts several paces behind her at head height and pushes slowly toward her while rising smoothly and drifting a little to the right, so the stairs and the arch grow in the frame and the view through the arch opens over her shoulder. She stays still apart from her cloak stirring in a light breeze, and the terrace stays quiet and empty apart from her for the whole shot.
A light breeze through the cypress trees, distant birdsong and the soft rustle of a wool cloak.
